note: Wood County park on the Yellow River, where two small dams form Lake Kaunewinne and Lake Manakiki; suspension bridge, swim beach and an 18-hole disc golf course (fee). Only sites 63-67 are on the water (Lake Manakiki). Most non-electric sites (84-99) are grass tent or tent-trailer sites with no pad. --Claude
summary: County park page, 2026/2027 fee PDFs, camping policies, closing notice, all 99 per-site pages and the map read: 76 x 50A electric + 23 non-electric, no water/sewer at sites, no pull-throughs; 2027 $23/$28/$31 (off-season $20/$25) + $10 fee; reservations required, same-day OK, 3-night holiday minimum, 14 max; May 1 - Oct 30; showers, laundry, dump. Lakefront kept with a caveat: only waterfront sites 63-67, ~20-32 m from Lake Manakiki (11 ac).
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakefront (--Claude) kept, with the note naming the sites. The county types only sites 63-67 'Waterfront: Yes' (sold nightly at $31, electric 50A, pads 45-55 ft). Map and Esri imagery place them at ~44.5168-44.5158,-90.1428 on the lake side of the campground road just south of the Kaunewinne dam; pads ~20-32 m from Lake Manakiki (11 acres, over the 5-acre pond line) across a grassy bank with scattered deciduous trees and an open grass strip at the shore - read on leaf-off imagery, and the site pages call them 'Shady', so a reviewer may see this as filtered (*view). Lake Kaunewinne (5 acres) is pond-sized; no site is on it. The other 94 sites are not on the water.
